request: i want to add more randomizations to the hover states like, for example, a size change of the button and it's encapsulated by a wireframe and it follows your cursor and automatically adjusts, and what i coded with Chickpea. and i want to make sure for the colors, especially with jellybox, that the text is legible and can always be read properly. i want the hover states to also always be random for each button and be on the main menu too, and the main menu can also have the random size/aspect ratio adjustments for the buttons, smooth transitions as well /emil-design-eng and /antialgorithm and /metadump:metadump
thesis: A hover on this site is a small generative composition: the glitch is the constant, and everything after it is drawn from a seeded deck, the way Chickpea draws a grid and a palette from a seed, so no two hovers are the same and every one still reads.
job: point at any button, the home menu included, and see the glitch land
see a hover that differs from the last one on that button: size, aspect, a wireframe, a Chickpea move, a lineage effect
move the cursor inside the button and watch the wireframe follow and re-fit
read the label at every frame, on every band colour and on JellyBox's glass
leave and see everything settle back with no layout moved
click and get the press, then the page change
use the keyboard or a finger and get a calm, instant end frame
with reduced motion, get the still end frame and no travel
see the skeleton: the box and an X joining its opposite corners, on the JellyBox X and on every wired hover
move the cursor and watch the band's shape morph after it, always holding the whole label
watch letters change face without shoving their neighbours: they glide and blur in, and leave as softly

chickpea_repo: globalanomalyindex/chickpea @ c55533e, his own: 'a generative grid + color studio that draws you the math behind any composition'
pure seeded core, no React: (seed, dials) => grid, and a palette twin; mulberry32 prng; hashSeed(string)

grids are guillotine slice-trees: every cut crosses its rectangle, so a zero-gap tiling is structural; generators: recursive, modular, nature; composeGrid(seed, boxes, W, H) anchors a grid to live boxes
ratios snap to named positions and labels are truthful: a golden cut reads '1/φ', never a rounded decimal (ratios.ts ratioName)

palette sampled in OKLCH from a von Mises hue mixture; harmonize = enforceSpread (lightness range >= 0.28, L clamped 0.08..0.96) + dedupe + hero first; scored on contrast, separation, harmony, focal, anti-mud, vibrancy

the alive hero (InteractionLayer.tsx): hover MEASURES; the nearest seam spring-separates (DELTA 24, RADIUS 150), cursor-tracked dimension arrows light up with numbers that never collide (layoutLabels), at most 3 at once; arrows track the cursor 1:1 by transform with no transition; nudges spring by per-frame lerp 0.24 (~8 frames)
hairline svg everywhere: stroke 1.5 for arrows, 1 for guides; dashed guides '3 3' and ghosts '2 3'; arrowhead 5, end cap 3; fades 150ms cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1)

MorphGrid.tsx: a whisper grid built from the real engine, invisible at rest, blooms with cursor activity (max opacity .16), spotlight radius 230 around the cursor, crossfades between fresh engine grids every 4.2s over 640ms, optional blur(2px) bridge; only transform and opacity animate
reduced motion: nudges snap to 0, arrows render statically, no morph cadence
site_now: every hover: the glitch on 50ms drawings (ink.ts), band from the entry edge, two strips, letters spread from the pointer
lineage deck (lineage.ts): after 220ms dwell, 1 in 4 deals Mark, Decode, Knockout, Jelly, Shear, Bayer or Canister; menu rows only Decode or Canister
menu rows keep their page hue (it previews the page): designs #F5D90A, paintings #12D9E8, about #FF2D87, resume #C9F227
seams.ts + skeleton.ts are already Chickpea's hero, improved: prose words and buttons as units, dt springs, measure ink #3F5195, a hovered inline button claims 14px and shows its measurements
three properties move a button: transform (magnet), translate (seams), scale (press); hover never changes a layout box (checked)
band ink #1A1820; every HUE holds band ink at 5:1 or better; Jelly picks the JellyBox pigment nearest the band's hue from those whose highlighted state holds 4.5:1

descriptions: a box's two diagonals meet at its centre: the oldest draughting trick for finding it

map lettering's halo: each glyph carries a thin outline in the colour behind it, so a line passing under the type stops a hair from each letter's own shape, never at a box
a mask cut at a rectangle reads as something laid on top of the line; a halo reads as the line passing behind

round_5_lineage.said: 1. the after tokens-inspired animation can be more faithful and better looking - use /emil-design-eng and /design-motion-principles ; 2. the mfny hover feels strange with sub-hover states in the main hover, we need to think - use /emil-design-eng. 3. any effect bands need to be random but always aligned with text. 6. the dither hover freezes after a few seconds and needs to not freeze. the glitching effect into the hover effect sometimes feels... not smooth, or unintentional. we need to use /design-motion-principles and /choreograph and /emil-design-eng to fix.
round_5_lineage.decided_by: Fable 5.2 at xhigh as lead, built by an Opus 5.5 expert, with /emil-design-eng, /design-motion-principles and /choreograph
round_5_lineage.decision: every lineage effect waits 80ms after the dwell, so the settled glitch holds two drawings and the effect is a second beat; one text grid (runtime/fx/textgrid.ts) decides where any band, seam or spot may fall, never inside a word, with random picks from the button's own seeded stream; the dither is rebuilt on dither's real ordered rule as a spot on the words under the cursor that follows it word by word with follow: true; Skeleton is rebuilt on After Tokens' shipping growing skeleton with its capsule division and 280ms handover at real tempo; Tricode is one opening and one choice with nothing inside the link answering the pointer; Knockout is made legible with ground-ink copies of every glyph and a stepped spread on clear seams
round_5_lineage.why: the dither froze because it read the live pointer but never asked for frames once the clock stopped 900ms after the dwell; a 20ms gap between the glitch's last drawing and the effect read as a stutter, and first drawings popped; bands sat on a 24px tile, on percentages or on thirds, slicing letters; a hover state inside one link implies three targets where there is one, and MFNY's own spec stops motion under the cursor; Skeleton ran a score After Tokens no longer renders, 48 times too fast; Knockout's copy rendered in band ink at 2.36:1
round_5_lineage.built_note: Skeleton tuned inside the 30ms bound after filming: the ink leaves in 60ms and the division runs 30 to 210ms, because at 0 to 180 the capsule split under the still-fading text and never read as one capsule; Knockout's copy letters keep their original's kerned width, since a letter set alone is a little wider; lineage chunk 22.92 kB gzipped

request_7.cut: the '+' glitch at the click (pulled the eye to the corner), Coalesce (its job was carrying the click to the '+'), the 100ms wait before the cover going up

round_5_performance.said: any optimizations for performance can and should be done
round_5_performance.decided_by: Fable 5.2 (lead, set the budgets), built by an Opus 5.5 expert with /animation-performance
round_5_performance.decision: nothing a visitor sees changes, only what it costs: JellyBox's loop parks while the X is at rest (jx-clock.ts, the vendored renderer kept byte for byte); painting tiles load 480 and 800px copies through srcset and a sizes worked out from site.css, drawn at the same size; a pointer move reads the button's box once in the event and the magnet writes its lean once in the next frame; the seams stop measuring a hovered box once it has settled (the magnet's 140ms follow, its 440ms spring, the press); pool() keeps the spans it made and each host its outline, so a clock frame makes no DOM queries
round_5_performance.why: every subpage ran 60 empty frames a second forever (301 callbacks and about 80ms of main thread per 5s of idle), and a second loop after the first Jelly row; paintings loaded twenty 1200px files for tiles drawn 147 to 493px wide; each move wrote the lean and then read the box again, forcing a style recalc every move; resting on a link in a sentence redrew the skeleton every frame for as long as it was hovered
round_5_performance.built_note: measured in headless Chrome at 1440 x 900 on the built site, before then after: idle subpage 301 callbacks / 72 to 87ms per 5s, then 0 / 3 to 5ms; after leaving the X or a Jelly row 120 and 240 callbacks per 2s, then 0; paintings first screen 3,979 kB (3,637 kB of pictures), then 786 kB (443 kB); 120 moves in a hovered row, frames counted, 225 recalcs (107 forced by script) in 120 frames, then 119 in 121 and none forced, median task 215 then 170ms; resting on a sentence link, per second, 122 callbacks, 180 layouts and 119ms, then 0, 0 and under 1ms; a resting hover on a row, 27 clock frames with 109 DOM queries, then 26 frames with 8, all at its start; a menu row's figure cell read before the overlay is written, two sweeps down home's menu 138 layouts then 125; measured and left alone: caching the X box's size for the optics (removed 26 forced recalcs per 2s hover, no measurable time: 215 vs 214ms); the seams step walking every unit (about 0.08ms a frame on chellbook); a load-time pass (largest task on chellbook 8ms); scrolling paintings (largest task 4ms); the signature after it hands back (0 frames on home at rest)

round_5_paintings_and_dress.said: 4. on the paintings page, hovering sometimes makes the text rearrange to fit - i want the text to always fit and the words to not shift from non-hover to hover. on the same page, as well, some of the titles are on different levels relative to the painting - some upper, some lower. they should all be on the same level. / 3. any effect bands need to be random but always aligned with text. / 6. ... the glitching effect into the hover effect sometimes feels... not smooth, or unintentional.
round_5_paintings_and_dress.decided_by: Fable 5.2 as lead (D1 to D7), built and filmed by one of three engineers
round_5_paintings_and_dress.decision: paintings stand on the bottom of their boxes (object-position 50% 100%), so every title sits right on its picture and every title in a row is on one level, and the film reads that position; the hover keeps the resting lines (nowrap, a forced break before each resting line's first letter), its letters add nothing to the line box, a last line too wide with its '...' drops the '...', a line still too wide is narrowed, and a title breaks anywhere rather than leave its tile; Reach and Ratio stop only between blocks of type (each block's cell: the text plus a quarter em, out to the mono cell) and never left of the label's; the Cut's cuts across move to the gaps between the lines of the row's tallest block; the dress begins 80ms after the dwell, on the 300ms drawing, a cell is drawn only inside the band's target and grows from its side nearer the cursor
round_5_paintings_and_dress.why: a wrapped title's hover face wrapped on its own in the narrower face, so 'to' and 'enough' jumped a line; the 1.14em face stretched every line box, so every hovered label sat 3 to 4px low and a second line about 10px low; a wide painting sat in the middle of its box, 20 to 89px above its title, while a tall one touched it; a band edge could stop between letters ('en|gine') and the Cut cut at golden sections, not between lines; the dress began one frame after the glitch landed, which read as a stutter, and a cell could wipe in only to be clipped away
round_5_paintings_and_dress.built_note: measured: baseline shift on hover 4px before, 0px after (Chrome; 0.1px or less in WebKit); line pitch unchanged on hover; every title's gap to its painting 0px at every width (was 0 to 89px); the dress first draws 300 to 317ms after entry on a 60Hz clock, filmed at 311 to 313ms (it used to start on the frame that met the 220ms dwell, 220 to 237ms). The checks find a baseline with an empty inline span, because a zero-size inline-block gives a long unbroken word a place to break before it and reads 0.67px off. REST stayed at 80.

round_5_integration.said: all six notes, merged: "use 3 expert subagents ... orchestrated ... by Fable 5.2 ... and maintains the code and its health"
round_5_integration.decided_by: Fable 5.2 as lead integrator; finished by the session after the integrator stopped
round_5_integration.decision: the rest before an effect or the dress is one number (REST in buttons.ts) both read; the unrounded layout width (widthOf) and the 4.5:1 band-ink test (holdsInk) each live in one place; a squeezed title keeps its squeeze as the overlay's own scale, so an effect writing transform composes with it; Knockout's copies take the original's unrounded width and ride the glitch's last glide; the dead Bayer mask CSS is gone
round_5_integration.why: the three branches each carried their own copy of the rest, the width and the contrast test; a copy of a detail a quarter pixel narrower than its original sent a full line's last word down a line under Knockout; Decode writing transform wiped a title's squeeze, so a title in capitals ran out of its tile
